description: Parity between the public spec conformance corpus and the reference implementation. For each corpus input the reference output (or thrown error) is recorded next to the corpus expectation; `agrees` is true when they match. canonicalization: reference scheme canonicalize(raw) with `null` for a rejected value; parse: reference parse (first-two-colons split, closed registry) with `null` for a rejected string; norm1: reference NORM-1; gen1: reference gen1 builder — the reference exposes no preimage, so `preimageReconstructed` is rebuilt from the reference NORM-1 (sorted keys, compact JSON) and `preimageHashMatchesIid` confirms keccak16(preimage) equals the IID hash segment.
